title: AI Friendly
description: With this Plugin, you can summon a bot/player on your server which follows you around and can talk with you with the help of Gemini (free to use)
body:
With this Plugin, you can summon a bot/player on your server which follows you around and can talk with you with the help of Gemini
_(free to use)_

### First-Time Setup

**To use the plugin, after downloading and putting into server and getting in the game,**
**you have to use your own token for the AI.**
**The token needs to be from Google AI Studio.**
 **Please go to [Google AI Studio API Keys](https://aistudio.google.com/api-keys)**

![AI Studio Login](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2fef145b3fa348ac7123e8ee35961ac9c1e2a844.webp)

(https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2fef145b3fa348ac7123e8ee35961ac9c1e2a844.webp)
**Copy the API Key you get after creating a project and adding whatever names you want.**
In the game, use the command
**/token** (your token)]
![Token verified](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8aa82ee5196126c5ad049e2eacf63fe1f2c78004.png)

You will need to do this every time you start the server so 
**I recommend Saving The API Key.**


**After it validates the API Key, do**

**/summonai** _(Bot name)_

_(10 second cooldown on every message so the AI doesn't get overloaded)_

**If you want to delete the bot to maybe make a new one, use the command**

**/killai**
_(Max one bot at a time)_


```
This plugin is only server-side and doesn't need any mods.
It could be a cool party trick for your friends.
If you want anything added, join the discord server and I will definetly respond.
The plugin isn't finished and will get more features.
```
Works best on 1.21.x
